# Bill Jeferson Nababan

> Fullstack developer in Batam, Indonesia. Takes features from the database table to the screen: REST APIs in Node.js and Express, data in MySQL and PostgreSQL (some MongoDB), and React front ends. Studied Informatics Engineering at Batam State Polytechnic. Certified RHCSA (Red Hat, 2023) and Junior Web Programmer (BNSP, 2024).

This site is a single page. Each section below is an anchor on it.

- [Story](https://billjeferson.vercel.app/#story): background, education and focus
- [Work](https://billjeferson.vercel.app/#work): two case studies (E-Depot, a container depot operations system used across six depots; a reminder app for Kalimantan Prima Persada) and four more projects with stack, role and source links
- [Skills](https://billjeferson.vercel.app/#skills): databases, APIs, front ends and tooling
- [Certifications](https://billjeferson.vercel.app/#certifications): RHCSA, BNSP Junior Web Programmer, Infinite Learning Web Technical Mentor

- [CV (PDF)](https://billjeferson.vercel.app/images/CV_BillJeferson.pdf): résumé
